competitors.name: Totino's / General Mills
competitors.action: Totino's is launching FaZe Clan Buffalo Style Chicken Pizza Rolls nationally in July, extending its multiyear esports partnership into a new 50-count frozen pizza-roll flavor at a $6.22 suggested retail price. The signal for Real Dough is that mass frozen pizza brands are still using entertainment partnerships and snackable formats to create freezer-aisle attention beyond traditional pizza SKUs.

competitors.name: Natural Grocers
competitors.action: Natural Grocers expanded its private-label freezer set with four made-in-Italy Organic Frozen Ravioli varieties, certified organic, 20 ounces and priced at $8.49. The launch is relevant because a natural/specialty retailer is using imported provenance, organic standards and convenience to make private label feel premium in the frozen Italian meal occasion.

competitors.name: Premier Protein / Hometown Food Co.
competitors.action: Premier Protein and Hometown Food Co. added frozen protein waffles, chocolate-chip protein waffles and mini protein pancakes at select retailers including Walmart, with 13 to 15 grams of protein per serving and a $5.98 to $6.98 suggested retail range. The useful signal is that functional protein positioning keeps moving deeper into mainstream frozen convenience, raising shopper expectations for clear nutritional benefits in the freezer aisle.
